title: Quantile Randomized Kaczmarz Algorithm with Whitelist Trust Mechanism
summary: Randomized Kaczmarz (RK) is a simple and fast solver for consistent overdetermined systems, but it is known to be fragile under noise. We study overdetermined $m\times n$ linear systems with a sparse set of corrupted equations, $ {\bf A}{\bf x}^\star = {\bf b}, $where only $\tilde{\bf b} = {\bf b} + \boldsymbol{\varepsilon}$ is observed with $\|\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}\|_0 \le βm$. The recently introduced QuantileRK (QRK) algorithm addresses this issue by testing residuals against a quantile threshold, but computing a per-iteration quantile across many rows is costly.
